canonical_project: Gangneung DC PEF 1GW AI Data Center Cluster
notes: Local media report a groundbreaking in Gangneung for a 1 GW hyperscale AI data-center complex by Gangneung DC PEF, planned around Gangdong-myeon/Aninjin-ri and Okgye-myeon, with phased completion targeted by 2028. Financing and final customer details remain uncertain.
